title: Ilizwi Eladibanisa Iintaba
intro: Umphefumlo olungileyo wanikwa izipho ezingaqhelekanga ezivela emazulwini, waba ngumlawuli nomloli ondalo yakhe yayibonakala ngathi idibene nendalo ngokwayo. Ibali labo lijikeleza kwisiprofeto, ubukumkani, kunye nobugcisa, lishiya ilifa elivakala kumaphepha esityhilelo sikaThixo.
clues: Ndakhethwa njengomkhonzi ka-Allah ndaza ndanikwa ubukumkani obunamandla phakathi kwabantu abakhethiweyo.
Iintaba neentaka beziza kuvumelana nam ekuzukiseni Osenyangweni.
Intsimbi yaba thambile njengodongwe ezandleni zam, ngentando ka-Allah kuphela.
Ndenza izixhobo zokuzikhusela ezazikhusela amajoni xa kushushu imfazwe.
Ndakha ndaphumelela uvavanyo olunzima xa abantu ababini ababengavisisani bangena ngokungalindelekanga kwindawo yam yonqulo.
Ndikhankanywa kunye nomlawuli owayelawula umoya kunye neejinn - kuba loo mlawuli wayeyinzala yam.

trial.label: Uvavanyo/Isiganeko
options: Abantu ababini abaphikisanayo bangena ngokungena kwindawo yam yonqulo
Ndajongana nomkhukula omkhulu owatshabalalisa abantu bam
Wavavanywa ngokulahlekelwa yintsapho yonke kunye nobutyebi
trial.answer: Abantu ababini abaphikisanayo bangena ngokungena kwindawo yam yonqulo

outcome.label: Isiphumo
options: Wafumana iiNdumiso (Zabur) waza wamiselwa njengomlawuli olungileyo
Wasindiswa esiswini sentlanzi kwaye abantu bakholelwa
Ndibuyiselwe empilweni kwaye ndinikwe iintsikelelo ezingakumbi
outcome.answer: Wafumana iiNdumiso (Zabur) waza wamiselwa njengomlawuli olungileyo

arabic: أَنِ ٱعْمَلْ سَـٰبِغَـٰتٍۢ وَقَدِّرْ فِى ٱلسَّرْدِ ۖ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَـٰلِحًا ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌۭ
verse: [Commanding him], "Make full coats of mail and calculate [precisely] the links, and work [all of you] righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Seeing." (34:11)
